text: Happy Friday everyone! Anyone got fun weekend plans? I’m thinking of finally taking Milo to the dog park if it ever stops raining.

Haha, Milo’s gonna love that. I’m just hoping my cat doesn’t break anything else—she knocked my coffee over *again* this morning. Also, did anyone else see that meme about cats being liquid? Too real 😂
Lol, I saw that! The one where the cat fits in the glass bowl? That’s basically Milo with laundry baskets, except he’s 60 lbs and it never ends well.
Wait, is this the meme? https://imgur.com/a/catliquid I sent it to my sister and she thought it was a bug report from our app at first 😂
Honestly, wouldn’t be surprised if our app started returning cats instead of error messages at this point. Happy weekend, y’all!
